resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source DFT code with DFT+U and elastic constant capabilities)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT code supporting GGA+U and stress-strain elastic constant method is acceptable.
SSSP efficiency library or equivalent GBRV ultrasoft pseudopotentials with appropriate valence configurations.

Standard pyrochlore structure: space group Fd-3m (No. 227), Gd at 16d (0,0,0), Zr at 16c (1/2,1/2,1/2), O at 48f (x,0.125,0.125) with x=0.339 and 8b (3/8,3/8,3/8). Lattice constant a=10.666 Å. The agent constructs supercells from this information; no external file needed.
